description: This Java class 'Policy' manages device security policies, including password requirements, within an Android device administration context. It provides methods to save and retrieve policy parameters, check administrative status, and configure device policies accordingly. The class also includes an internal DeviceAdminReceiver subclass 'PolicyAdmin' for handling administrative events.

classes.name: Policy
classes.description: Main class for managing device password policies and device admin status in Android.

methods.name: Policy
methods.description: Constructor initializing context and device policy manager, setting default values.

methods.name: saveToLocal
methods.description: Saves password policy parameters to shared preferences.

methods.name: readFromLocal
methods.description: Reads password policy parameters from shared preferences.

methods.name: getPolicyAdmin
methods.description: Returns the ComponentName for the device admin receiver.

methods.name: isAdminActive
methods.description: Checks if the app is currently active as device administrator.

methods.name: isActivePasswordSufficient
methods.description: Checks if the current password policy is sufficient.

methods.name: isDeviceSecured
methods.description: Returns true if device admin is active and password is sufficient.

methods.name: configurePolicy
methods.description: Applies the password policies to the device using DevicePolicyManager.
